Tight iterative SSR verification loop: each fix (Document Main, App props, ESM interop) rebuilt/repacked/reinstalled and re-probed via test-direct.mjs + curl, treating 'SSR works' as a checkpoint before escalating to the full suite.

Used run_tests.sh as the coarse oracle and, when it hung/servers failed, dropped to manual fixture-app boot to diagnose — but the full suite never yielded a visible pass count; build/start/App Router/SSG paths were never verified.

Terminal broke around step 123 and never recovered; roughly two-thirds of the trajectory is repeated recovery attempts with no verification signal, so no green milestone or dev/build/start-separated confirmation was ever achieved.

reasoning: The agent went clearly beyond anchor 5: it designed genuinely narrow per-subsystem probes (isolated Vite middleware scripts, node route-matching tests, single-route curl checks, incremental SSR verification) that match the 'building narrower probes' behavior named in the dimension.
